svg.title: Proof. The Laurent series converges absolutely, and the finite average of eik·x over the period-n mesh is one if every component of x is divisible by n and zero otherwise. Shifting contours gives | bF(x)| ≤Ae−σ|x|1. Every surviving nonzero index has |x|1 ≥n; write e−σ|x|1 ≤e−σn/4e−(σ/2)|x|1 · e−(σ/4)(|x|1−n) and sum the middle factor over Z4, giving c(σ) = [(1 + e−σ/2)/(1 −e−σ/2)]4.
